instagram.caption:
Unpopular opinion: open worlds are too big.

Assassin's Creed Valhalla takes over 60 hours to finish. Most of that is copy-paste map icons, not adventure. Velen in The Witcher 3 works because every village has a hand-made story. Size never made it great. Majora's Mask fits a whole world into one small map you remember forever. Smaller and denser wins. Agree?
